summary:
At the cited prospective 0.106 source candidate, explicit selected Codex rollout files share the maintained strict native decoder, including recursive duplicate-property and strict UTF8 refusal, and project actual optional response counters through provider-usage-observation/1. Item, inventory and terminal attribution stay unknown/partial; these canonical-only facts never enter qualified item totals. Stable native thread/turn/response identities, a finite serialized producer index, private pending intent and existing immutable spool retain corrections and exact replay. Local enqueue/reporting make no receiver or App Server call. Initial capture-only setup skips credential presence and reports receiver unverified. Same-owner state cloning/migration is unsupported without original state/fence reconciliation; one selected association root is the supported ownership boundary.

Receiver admission refuses cross-owner changes. A complete bounded drain census retains the earliest pending head for each structural scope/source/generation, fencing numeric successors behind uncertain or durable-but-not-applied receipts. Candidate scheduling rotates eligible independent heads and ordinary traffic through the existing sixteen-envelope quantum with one private advisory cursor of at most 256 bytes. The cursor advances under the configuration lock immediately before each actual head attempt, rather than skipping a whole selected quantum. Expired shared deadline/cancellation stops new head attempts; canceled lookup cannot proceed to Submit. Missing/invalid cursor state resets deterministic order. Cursor crashes affect ordering only; queued bytes, receipts and authority remain unchanged. No fixed elapsed-time or eight-pass service guarantee follows; transport timeouts and exact-source tests remain separate.

Unsupported/rejected passive data remains pending. Full qualification of this unified source, publication, installed producer capture, compatible receiver Host/store and restart/restore durability remain unaccepted here. Host is independently versioned; first useful isolated candidate capture does not wait on Home access or Host deployment. Published/installed 0.105 and the accepted board binding stay unchanged. Earlier records and original failures/Unknown operations remain retained with no replay or reservation release.
title: Passive native responses separate capture, attribution and delivery
